card.name: Teaching and R-tutorial blog prose
card.fires_on: Ordinary words in educator or statistics blog posts, such as 'ers' in High schoolers, 'set' in 'a set of links', 'previously', or sentence-starting 'The' and 'It'. It is not tied to one word type.
